title: support-bot Helm values
description: JSON Schema for support-bot chart values. Enforced by Helm 3 BEFORE any template rendering, so a bad install fails fast at the client with a clear error. WP03 updates the schema to allow secrets to be supplied via External Secrets Operator (default) OR via inline chart values (legacy, for WP03 transition + local tests). The 'useLegacySecretInlining' toggle switches the schema's `secret.openaiApiKey` requirement.

useLegacySecretInlining.description: WP03 toggle. When true (legacy default for backward compat with WP03 transition), the chart requires inline secret.openaiApiKey matching the sk-<base62> regex. When false (post-WP03 default), the chart relies on ExternalSecrets to populate secret values from AWS Secrets Manager.

secret.description: API keys + tokens mounted as a Kubernetes Secret. When useLegacySecretInlining=true, all values MUST be supplied at install time. When false (WP03 default), values are pulled from AWS Secrets Manager via External Secrets Operator and this object can be empty.

openaiApiKey.description: OpenAI API key for the answerer adapter. Required when useLegacySecretInlining=true (sk-<base62>, >=20 chars after prefix). Use null when useLegacySecretInlining=false.

embeddingApiKey.description: OpenAI API key for the OpenAI embedder backend. Optional -- only required when EMBEDDER_BACKEND=openai. Use null when not needed.

chromaAuthToken.description: Chroma auth token. Optional. Use null for unauthenticated Chroma.

config.description: Application configuration mounted as a Kubernetes ConfigMap (WP04 / composition/settings.py).

logLevel.description: Application log level (DEBUG/INFO/WARNING/ERROR). Defaults to INFO in values.yaml.

sourceUrl.description: URL the ingestion pipeline scrapes on first start (FR-001 / PageScraper port). Must be a non-empty absolute HTTP(S) URL -- the ingestion cannot scrape an empty or relative URL.

answererBackend.description: Answerer implementation selector. 'openai' = ChatOpenAI (default), 'fake' = deterministic for tests.

analyzerBackend.description: WP06 page analyzer selector. 'openai' = OpenAIPageAnalyzer (LLM-driven, default), 'none' = skip the analyze step (FixedSizeChunker fallback).

chunkerBackend.description: WP06 chunker selector. 'hybrid' = HybridChunker (consumes PageStructure; default), 'fixed_size' = FixedSizeChunker (WP03 fallback).

openaiPageAnalyzerModel.description: WP06 OpenAI chat-completions model used by the page analyzer (e.g. 'gpt-4o-mini').

lowConfidenceThreshold.description: Cosine similarity floor below which LowConfidencePolicy refuses to answer. Pydantic v2 parses this as a string -> Decimal.
